get.summary: Get current authenticated user and session

post.description: Registration is disabled by default. Token-protected ordinary registration creates a user, default Member, UserMember binding, Space admin grant, and session inside the deployment-level Simple Mode default Space. First-super-admin bootstrap requires PLYSTRA_BOOTSTRAP_REGISTRATION_ENABLED plus PLYSTRA_BOOTSTRAP_REGISTRATION_TOKEN. Public user-only registration with PLYSTRA_AUTH_PUBLIC_USER_REGISTRATION_ENABLED creates only a User and does not create a Member, UserMember binding, admin grant, or session.

get.summary: List installed capability states and services

post.summary: Issue a governed capability invocation grant
post.description: Resolves an enabled capability provider, verifies the caller declared the required capability, records a revocable grant ledger row, and returns a target endpoint plus opaque grant token. Core does not proxy the business payload.
Immediately revokes a mediated capability grant so provider runtimes fail closed on their next introspection before execution.

post.summary: Record a capability grant outcome receipt
post.description: Provider runtimes report idempotent execution outcomes so Core can reconcile mediated grants without being in the synchronous business-response path.

post.summary: Create or update a capability provider binding
post.description: Binds a Space capability operation to an enabled provider plugin. Rebinding increments binding_epoch so callers re-request grants after provider changes.
